mechanism: Both agents are nephrotoxic and can cause severe renal impairment; foscarnet chelates divalent cations including calcium, increasing hypocalcemia risk when combined with zoledronic acid's calcium-lowering effects.
action: Monitor renal function and serum electrolytes (calcium, phosphate, magnesium) closely; ensure adequate hydration; consider dose adjustment or increased monitoring interval; assess baseline renal function before co-administration.
